summary: Created a 12-phase design plan settling the OTel/events.jsonl seam and the /distill redesign into 12 sub-modes plus the skill-learn/skill-distill split. Plan grounding found a material correction to the research report: the cwd/repo-tag half of the seam is ALREADY fully implemented (schema property, events-append.sh --cwd, both hooks capturing from stdin, events-query.sh --repo derivation), so cc_session_id is the only genuinely new field. Design round only: 0 of 12 phases are implemented by design, so the completion gate must refuse - the user will /revise then /expand this plan. All planned edits target agent-system/extensions/**, never .claude/**.
decisions_made: cc_session_id (flat snake_case, nullable, optional) is the only new events.jsonl field; it follows the identical code path cwd already travels at every call site.
cwd/repo-tag is a preserved asset, not new work - it is already implemented end to end, contradicting the research report's recommendation.
The OTel <-> events.jsonl join is exact via cc_session_id = OTel session.id; no time-window heuristic, and the sess_* join stays a recorded dead end.
gen_ai.* names are borrowed as a citation vocabulary inside the already-open detail object only, never as top-level field names; no span/trace or collector infrastructure.

skill-memory/SKILL.md splits mechanically at line 1063 (## Mode: distill) into skill-learn and skill-distill, with restructuring deliberately deferred to a later phase so a failed split is a clean revert.
The seven-step sub-mode skeleton is stated once in a shared section; each sub-mode is reduced to deltas, and behavior preservation beats fitting the template.
--revise and --meta take the current dream sub-mode's two existing halves; --dream is redefined to history.jsonl-sourced speculative direction-finding with no correlation machinery of its own.
--meta consumes the existing GLOBAL_ROOT/cd-chaining/--local mechanism verbatim and delegates task creation to meta-builder-agent; it invents neither.

The four memory/event scripts need NO code change for cross-repo access - only an invocation discipline (chained cd + relative path in one Bash call), with absolute-path invocation named as a prohibition.

Design constraints (evaluator outside the loop, never auto-apply, ~70% v1 miss rate, six failure modes, no-new-hygiene-below-100) are factored into one citable guardrails context file instead of restated per sub-mode.
The seven existing hygiene sub-modes are frozen; only their position in the file changes.
Cross-repo events.jsonl aggregation is an explicit out-of-scope residual limit, documented in the --meta flag description itself.
dead_ends: Do not revive the sess_{ts}_{rand} join between the agent system and Claude Code - different id spaces, no structural link.
Do not add cwd to events-schema.json or a --cwd flag to events-append.sh - both already exist; re-adding them would be a no-op or a conflict.
Do not build a span/trace system, OTel collector, or new transcript parser.
